title: Map labelling #4
topic: university campus · wildlife park · botanical garden · holiday village
context:
Narrator: Map 1. The university campus.
Guide: Welcome to the university campus. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the student union. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the library. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the bike shed is the first building on your right.
Guide: The bookshop is directly behind the library, at the back of the site.
Guide: The health centre is directly behind the bike shed, at the back of the site.
Guide: The art studio is right next to the bookshop, on its left side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 2. The wildlife park.
Guide: Welcome to the wildlife park. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the petting farm. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the first-aid post is the first building on your right.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the café. It is the first building on your left.
Guide: The bird aviary is directly behind the café, at the back of the site.
Guide: The penguin pool is directly behind the petting farm, at the back of the site.
Guide: The butterfly house is directly behind the first-aid post, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 3. The botanical garden.
Guide: Welcome to the botanical garden. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the herb garden is the first building on your right.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the pond is the first building on your left.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the visitor centre is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: The play area is directly behind the visitor centre, at the back of the site.
Guide: The souvenir stall is directly behind the pond, at the back of the site.
Guide: The glasshouse is right next to the play area, on its right side.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
Narrator: Map 4. The holiday village.
Guide: Welcome to the holiday village. I will quickly show you where things are. Look at the map as I talk, and remember that you come in at the main entrance at the bottom.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the laundry. It is the building straight ahead of you.
Guide: As you come in through the main entrance, the restaurant is the first building on your left.
Guide: Just inside the entrance you will find the nature trail office. It is the first building on your right.
Guide: The bike hire is directly behind the laundry, at the back of the site.
Guide: The boat house is right next to the bike hire, on its right side.
Guide: The spa is directly behind the restaurant, at the back of the site.
Guide: That covers everything. Enjoy your visit.
